verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business offering documents call forwarding and call routing that can ring multiple numbers at once or roll to other numbers when the first isn't answered. That lets a founder send the business line to other phones, and the mobile app lets them answer business calls from anywhere. However, the docs never explicitly confirm forwarding to an external cell number or turning forwarding on when the team is away from the desk, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation of forwarding to an external cell number, a schedule- or availability-based (away/after-hours) forwarding mode, setup detail for configuring forwarding, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk

citations.quote: Set up call routing and call forwarding
Incoming calls can ring multiple numbers at once, or roll to different numbers if the first one isn’t answered
